name: english-writing-assistant
description: Chrome extension for lightweight English writing correction

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ewa/shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w extension
scripts.test: npm run test -w @ewa/shared && npm run test -w extension && npm run test -w backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @ewa/shared && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w extension
